mapper.select:
select a.ref_id as refId, a.keeper_id as keeperId, a.grid_id as gridId, b.grid_classification as gridClassification,a.delete_flag as deleteFlag, b.grid_name as gridName, b.grid_range gridRange from bm_grid_keeper_ref a left join bm_grid b on a.grid_id=b.grid_id where a.keeper_id = #{keeperId,jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.delete_flag = 0
and a.grid_id = #{gridId}

SELECT keeper_id, keeper_code, keeper_name, longitude, latitude,keeper_type,is_grid_manager FROM bm_gridkeeper a WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 and a.`status` = '0' ${dataScope} and EXISTS(SELECT b.keeper_id FROM bm_grid_keeper_ref b WHERE b.delete_flag = '0' and b.grid_id = #{gridId} AND b.keeper_id = a.keeper_id) order by a.keeper_sort

select a.grid_id,b.keeper_id, a.grid_code, a.grid_name, a.gb_code, a.parent_id, a.parent_code, a.grid_classification, a.grid_level, a.grid_level_code, a.grid_property, a.is_end, a.grid_address, a.grid_introduce, a.grid_picture, a.regin_scope_desc, a.grid_sort, a.point_status, a.grid_em_center, a.grid_begin_time, a.grid_end_time, a.grid_area, a.is_valid, a.creator, a.create_time, a.delete_flag, a.color, a.grid_center, a.grid_range, a.tenant_id, a.industry_code from bm_grid a left join bm_grid_keeper_ref b on a.grid_id=b.grid_id AND b.delete_flag = 0 where b.keeper_id = #{keeperId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND a.delete_flag = 0 ${dataScope}

SELECT USER_ID AS user_id, DEPT_ID AS staff_org_id, NICK_NAME as keeper_name, SEX as keeper_gender, PHONENUMBER as keeper_phone_number, EMAIL as keeper_email FROM sys_user WHERE USER_NAME = #{loginName} AND DEL_FLAG = '0'
SELECT count(*) FROM bm_gridkeeper a, bm_grid_keeper_ref b WHERE a.keeper_id = b.keeper_id AND b.grid_id = #{gridId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.status = 0 AND b.delete_flag = 0

SELECT a.keeper_id,a.keeper_name, CONCAT( SUBSTRING( a.keeper_phone_number, 1, 3 ), '****', SUBSTRING( a.keeper_phone_number, 8 )) AS keeper_phone_number FROM bm_gridkeeper a, bm_grid_keeper_ref b WHERE a.keeper_id = b.keeper_id AND b.grid_id = #{gridId} AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.status = 0 AND b.delete_flag = 0 AND a.keeper_type != '1'

SELECT id, label, pid, IF ( t.type = '3', '0', t.type ) AS type, tel, center, isLine, color, userId, userName, locationFlag FROM ( SELECT a.keeper_id AS id, a.keeper_name AS label, b.grid_id AS pid, '1' AS type, CONCAT(SUBSTRING( a.keeper_phone_number, 1, 3 ),'****',SUBSTRING( a.keeper_phone_number, 8 )) AS tel, concat(a.longitude,',',a.latitude) AS center, (case when TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,a.take_point_time,now())<5 then '1' else '0' end) as isLine, '' AS color, a.staff_id as userId, a.login_name as userName, a.location_flag as locationFlag FROM bm_gridkeeper a, bm_grid_keeper_ref b WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 AND b.delete_flag = 0 AND a.keeper_id = b.keeper_id AND a.STATUS = '0' AND a.keeper_type = '1' ${dataScope} UNION ALL SELECT s.keeper_id AS id, s.keeper_name AS label, ( CASE WHEN x.keeper_id IS NULL OR x.keeper_id = '' THEN s.grid_id ELSE x.keeper_id END ) AS pid, '2' AS type, s.tel, s.center AS center, (case when TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,s.take_point_time,now())<5 then '1' else '0' end) as isLine, '' AS color, s.userId, s.userName, s.locationFlag FROM ( SELECT a.keeper_id, a.keeper_name, b.grid_id, CONCAT(SUBSTRING( a.keeper_phone_number, 1, 3 ),'****',SUBSTRING( a.keeper_phone_number, 8 )) AS tel, a.take_point_time, concat(a.longitude,',',a.latitude) as center, a.staff_id as userId, a.login_name as userName, a.location_flag as locationFlag FROM bm_gridkeeper a, bm_grid_keeper_ref b WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 AND b.delete_flag = 0 AND a.keeper_id = b.keeper_id AND a.STATUS = '0' AND a.keeper_type = '2' ${dataScope} ) s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.keeper_id, a.keeper_name, b.grid_id FROM bm_gridkeeper a, bm_grid_keeper_ref b WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 AND b.delete_flag = 0 AND a.keeper_id = b.keeper_id AND a.STATUS = '0' AND a.keeper_type = '1' ${dataScope} ) x ON s.grid_id = x.grid_id UNION ALL SELECT a.grid_id AS id, a.grid_name AS label, a.parent_id AS pid, '3' AS type, '' AS tel, a.grid_center AS center, '' AS isLine, a.color, '' as userId, '' as userName, '' as locationFlag
FROM bm_grid a WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 and a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.industry_code = #{industryCode} ) t ORDER BY t.pid, t.type

SELECT id, label, pid, IF ( t.type = '3', '0', t.type ) AS type, tel, center, isLine, color, userId, userName, locationFlag FROM ( SELECT a.keeper_id AS id, a.keeper_name AS label, b.grid_id AS pid, a.keeper_type AS type, CONCAT(SUBSTRING( a.keeper_phone_number, 1, 3 ),'****',SUBSTRING( a.keeper_phone_number, 8 )) AS tel, concat(a.longitude,',',a.latitude) AS center, (case when TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,a.take_point_time,now())<5 then '1' else '0' end) as isLine, '' AS color, a.staff_id as userId, a.login_name as userName, a.location_flag as locationFlag FROM bm_gridkeeper a, bm_grid_keeper_ref b WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 AND b.delete_flag = 0 AND a.keeper_id = b.keeper_id AND a.STATUS = '0' ${dataScope} UNION ALL SELECT a.grid_id AS id, a.grid_name AS label, a.parent_id AS pid, '3' AS type, '' AS tel, a.grid_center AS center, '' AS isLine, a.color, '' as userId, '' as userName, '' as locationFlag FROM bm_grid a WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 and a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.industry_code = #{industryCode} ) t ORDER BY t.pid, t.type

SELECT (case when TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,a.take_point_time,now())<5 then '1' else '0' end) as isLine, b.grid_id as id, c.grid_level_code as gridLevelcode FROM bm_gridkeeper a, bm_grid_keeper_ref b, bm_grid c WHERE a.`status` = '0' AND a.delete_flag = 0 AND b.delete_flag = 0 AND c.delete_flag = 0 AND a.keeper_id=b.keeper_id AND b.grid_id=c.grid_id ${dataScope}

SELECT b.dept_name as staff_org_name, a.keeper_id, a.status, a.grid_type, a.keeper_code, a.staff_id, a.staff_id as userId, a.staff_org_id, a.login_name, a.entry_time, a.wechat_number, a.party, a.education, a.is_special, a.special_type, a.major_type, a.keeper_aidentity, a.keeper_motto, a.personal_profile, a.is_grid_manager, a.keeper_sort, a.star_class, a.creator, a.create_time, a.modifier, a.update_time, a.delete_flag, a.versions, IF(a.keeper_id_card_number, CONCAT( SUBSTRING( a.keeper_id_card_number, 1, 6 ), '********', SUBSTRING( a.keeper_id_card_number, 15 )), NULL ) AS keeper_id_card_number, a.keeper_birth_date, a.keeper_address, CONCAT(SUBSTRING( a.keeper_phone_number, 1, 3 ),'****',SUBSTRING( a.keeper_phone_number, 8 )) AS keeper_phone_number, a.keeper_phone_number as aes_phone_number, a.keeper_email, a.keeper_gender, a.keeper_name, a.longitude, a.latitude, a.take_point_time, a.tenant_id, a.fj_url, (case when TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,a.take_point_time,now())<5 then '1' else '0' end) as is_line, a.province_id, a.city_id, a.county_id, a.location_flag, a.keeper_type, a.operating_duty, a.industry_code, a.app_ver_code, re.grid_id, g.grid_name FROM bm_gridkeeper a LEFT JOIN sys_dept b ON a.staff_org_id = b.dept_id and b.del_flag=0 LEFT JOIN bm_grid_keeper_ref re on a.keeper_id = re.keeper_id LEFT JOIN bm_grid g on g.grid_id = re.grid_id WHERE a.delete_flag = 0 and g.delete_flag = 0 and re.delete_flag = 0 ${dataScope}
